Title: Executive Sales & Profitability
Business_Problem: Revenue is growing, but management is unsure whether growth is converting into healthy gross profit across products and channels.
Expected_Deliverable: Build an executive view of revenue, units, gross profit, margin, YoY/MoM growth, seasonality, product contribution, discount impact and clear management actions.

Title: Customer 360 & Retention
Business_Problem: The business has a growing customer base, but repeat behavior, customer value and retention quality are unclear.
Expected_Deliverable: Create customer segments using RFM/cohorts, repeat rate, retention, AOV, purchase frequency, high-value customer profiles and churn/retention opportunities.

Title: Branch & Channel Performance
Business_Problem: Retail, online and wholesale operate differently; the company needs to know which channel creates value, not just sales volume.
Expected_Deliverable: Compare channel growth, margin, returns, basket size, geographic demand and contribution. Identify underperformance and channel-mix opportunities.

Title: Inventory & Demand Planning
Business_Problem: Some SKUs tie up cash while other fast movers experience stockout days. No forecast is supplied.
Expected_Deliverable: Perform ABC/XYZ analysis, stock turns, days of cover, stockout/overstock diagnosis, then build your own 30/60/90-day demand forecast and replenishment logic.

Title: Marketing Effectiveness
Business_Problem: Spend is distributed across platforms, but management cannot see true efficiency by campaign, product and period.
Expected_Deliverable: Measure ROAS, CAC, CTR, conversion, attributed revenue, platform/product effectiveness, campaign outliers and budget reallocation recommendations.

Title: Factory Production & Bottlenecks
Business_Problem: Production orders show uneven efficiency and delays across lines and stages.
Expected_Deliverable: Analyze throughput, plan vs actual, reject rate, delay days, bottlenecks, overtime and capacity utilization; prioritize operational improvement actions.

Title: Quality, Returns & Cost of Poor Quality
Business_Problem: Customer returns and QC defects are not always analyzed together, making root causes hard to prioritize.
Expected_Deliverable: Build defect Pareto, quality loss, product/stage/root-cause views, connect quality to returns, and propose corrective-action priorities.

Title: Printing Performance & Downtime
Business_Problem: Printing yield and rework vary by machine and period, with downtime events affecting output.
Expected_Deliverable: Analyze machine yield, defect rate, reprint cost, downtime hours, failure reasons and machine-level performance; identify maintenance priorities.

Title: Supply Chain & Materials
Business_Problem: Material availability and supplier reliability can create factory delays, excess cost and shortages.
Expected_Deliverable: Measure supplier lead time, on-time delivery, acceptance rate, cost trend, material criticality and shortage risk; create a supplier/material action matrix.

Title: Integrated Management Story + Forecast
Business_Problem: Leadership needs one connected story from market demand to factory execution, not isolated charts.
Expected_Deliverable: Deliver a management dashboard/story that links sales, customers, marketing, inventory, supply chain, production and quality; include forecast/scenario assumptions and quantified actions.
